allow: PowerShell($p = Start-Process npm -ArgumentList "run","start" -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; "LENGTH: $\($r.Content.Length\)"; if \($r.Content -match "Furqan Ahmed Khan"\) { "NAME: found" }; if \($r.Content -match "Hello"\) { "HERO: found" }; if \($r.Content -match "application/ld\\+json"\) { "JSONLD: found" } } finally { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.StartTime -gt \(Get-Date\).AddMinutes\(-2\) } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue })
